description: This line plot illustrates the change in BPC (bits per character) over training steps for two models: XMoE Validating and a baseline model, as described in the paper "SimSMoE Solving Representational Collapse via Similarity Measure". The x-axis represents "Training Steps" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50,000 (indicated as 50 × 10³), with tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis represents "BPC" on a linear scale, ranging from 1.25 to 2.25. The "XMoE Validating" line is depicted in yellow with a dashed line style and circular markers, starting at a BPC of approximately 2.15 at step 0 and decreasing to about 1.25 by step 50,000, showing a steady decline followed by stabilization. The baseline model is shown as a magenta line with circular markers, beginning at a BPC of approximately 2.25 at step 0 and also decreasing to about 1.25 by step 50,000, with a similar trend to the XMoE Validating line. Both lines converge to a similar low BPC value after approximately 20,000 steps.
